heading: EXT. HIGH DESERT ROADHOUSE, NEW MEXICO TERRITORY - DUSK (1880)

units.text: EXT. HIGH DESERT ROADHOUSE, NEW MEXICO TERRITORY - DUSK (1880)
A shuttered adobe at the end of a long road.
A tied post with no horse.
Tumbleweeds crossing and recrossing a yard of cracked clay.
The wind that comes before weather.
A tin sign squeals on one hinge.
